newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares close at new all time high.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares close at new all time high.

text.p: Shares on Istanbul's stock exchange gained an average 1.84 percent in a continued rally on Monday despite profit-taking which erased part of the early gains, brokers said.

The IMKB National-100 .XU100 closed at a new all-time high of 1,054, up 19 points from Friday's previous record of 1,035, but down from a day's high of 1,068. It had surged six percent on Thursday and Friday after the new year holiday from December 27 to January 2.
